description: Source code for a web scraper class 'JulieGoodwin' that extracts recipe information from juliegoodwin.com.au, including title, author, times, yields, image, ingredients, and instructions.

classes.name: JulieGoodwin
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from juliegoodwin.com.au, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and returns the recipe title from the HTML.

methods.name: extract_time
methods.description: Generic method to extract time (prep or cook) based on keyword from HTML elements.

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Returns the preparation time in minutes.

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Returns the cooking time in minutes.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total time by summing prep and cook times.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns the number of servings or yields from the recipe.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Returns the URL of the recipe image.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns a list of ingredients for the recipe.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Returns the step-by-step instructions for the recipe.
